rationale: Two separate comparisons (provider_specialty, network_status) on the claim-level fields as the objective requires; the composite grouping is not requested and would only add small cells. All five metrics are computed; denial rate uses adjudicated claims (paid + denied) to match the portfolio definition, while fraud rate uses all claims by construction, and every rate is emitted with numerator and denominator. min_group_size=30 flags groups below the 30-claim stability threshold named in the task. The provider directory join is verified before it is relied on: join_check reports cardinality, unmatched keys and row counts for medical_claims.rendering_npi->providers.provider_npi (the manifest expects many-to-one, providers unique, 0 unmatched of 12,845), and provider_join uses a left join with a many_to_one assertion so no claim is dropped or multiplied and the before/after row counts are recorded. The ranking is the top 10 rendering providers by claim_count; min_claims=30 keeps the ranking to stable providers and cannot change the result because the top 10 by count of 12,845 claims across 150 providers each necessarily exceed 30. The report prints every rate as numerator / denominator, cites an artifact or metrics key for every result bullet, and carries the synthetic-data, descriptive-only, association-not-causation and small-groups caveats. No randomness is involved, so no seed is needed; metrics.json is produced by the pipeline from the same values shown in the report.
